mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing valbenazine and its active metabolite (NBI-98854) concentrations; additive CNS depression and serotonergic effects possible.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine side effects (sedation, akathisia, QT prolongation) and serotonin syndrome; consider dose adjustment or alternative antidepressant if excessive CNS effects occur.
